committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects employees of past and present contractors, subcontractors, grantees, and subgrantees funded by the Department of Housing and Urban Development.
dimensions.evidence: applies with respect to any contract, subcontract, grant, subgrant, or personal services contract funded using amounts appropriated to the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development

dimensions.assessment: Provides legal protections against reprisal for employees who disclose certain misconduct under past HUD contracts and grants.
dimensions.evidence: The bill expands these protections to apply to HUD contracts and grants signed before the law was enacted.

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations, budget allocations, or economic figures are mentioned in the text.
Amends the application scope of an existing federal whistleblower statute specifically for one federal department's funding recipients.
dimensions.evidence: Section 4712 of title 41, United States Code, shall apply with respect to any contract... funded using amounts appropriated to the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently and retroactively to all past, present, and future HUD contracts and grants.
dimensions.evidence: regardless of when the contract, subcontract, grant, subgrant, or personal services contract was executed

missing_information: The number of historical HUD contracts and grants affected by the retroactive application.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill makes existing whistleblower protections applicable retroactively to all past and present contracts and grants funded by the Department of Housing and Urban Development.
